summary: RentIQ property management application - removing admin and user authentication to make it fully public
architectural_notes: Application will be fully public with no authentication

existing_features.title: Remove all Internet Identity authentication logic from the frontend including SignInScreen, SignInRequiredDialog, and all authentication-related components
Remove AuthApprovalGate component or modify it to always render children without checking authentication or approval status
Remove useInternetIdentity hook dependencies and replace all authentication state checks with default authenticated state throughout the application
Remove admin role checks, staff restrictions, and approval status checks from all components and hooks including useStaffRestrictions, useAppMode, and useApprovalStatus
Remove useMutationGate hook or modify it to always return mutations as ready without checking authentication state
Modify useActor hook to create backend actor instances without requiring Internet Identity authentication or admin token parameters
Remove ApprovalRequiredScreen component and all approval request functionality from the frontend
Remove useBootstrapAdmin hook and all admin bootstrapping logic from the frontend

new_feature_requests.summary: Remove all admin and user login/authentication logic
Remove access control, user approval, and authentication mixins from backend/main.mo and disable all authentication checks in backend endpoints
Remove UserProfile data type and all user management endpoints from backend/main.mo including approval, profile, and admin check methods
